dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature following a parabolic spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the dorsal horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convexity defining a broad and smooth anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short horizontal projection with high vertical thickness from the apparent melon terminus.

other_distinctive_markers: High-saturation cyan color profile with a distinct dark longitudinal band across the mid-lateral flank.
